The ground remembers who laid it.

DM Pavers has shaped driveways, patios, and pool decks across Southwest Florida since 2013 — every stone set by hand, by the same crew, to outlast the people who built it.

Start your project See the process

Based in Fort Myers, family-run since 2013. Serving Lee County, including Cape Coral, Bonita Springs, Estero, and Sanibel.

Most paver jobs fail the same way

A crew you've never met, gone before the base has even cured.

A different subcontractor shows up each phase. Base prep gets rushed to hit a bid. Within a season the joints are weeds and the edges have started to shift.

  • Subcontracted labor you never actually meet
  • Base compaction skipped, or barely done
  • Settling, shifting, and weeds within a year
What we build instead

The same four people, start to finish, on every job.

The crew that measures your yard is the crew compacting your base and setting your last paver. We over-engineer what you'll never see, so what you do see stays flat for decades.

  • One four-person crew, no rotating subs
  • 8 inches of compacted base, engineered for Florida's water table
  • Polymeric joint sand and a written workmanship warranty

How a project actually happens.

Five stages, the same crew the whole way through. Tap a step for the detail.

Usually 45–60 minutes. We leave you with a rough layout and a sense of what's possible before any paperwork.
You'll see paver cost, base material, labor, and drainage work broken out separately, not bundled into one round number.
This is the stage nobody sees and the one that decides whether your pavers are flat in ten years. We don't shortcut it.
Compacted twice — once mid-install, once at the end — so the surface settles before you ever walk on it.
We point out drainage lines and care notes directly — not in a PDF you'll lose track of.
